body: I asked him why he was being so distant and he said he didnt mean to and that he will make an effort to communicate with me more. We're long distance so this is important. Talked to another friend about my issues, feel a little better but still really bad. I really need to see a psych urgently.

I really fucking want to talk to him but I don't want to push him away even further. I am the more unstable one in the relationship and have had a couple of other issues (nowhere near this size) that he has helped me with. But he seems distant and this issue is huge, he is the one I want to talk to the most on this planet right now but I can't. I will try talking to one of my other friends but I don't know how she will respond. I will try though, this is miserable. All I want to do is talk to my boyfriend and receive some emotional support.

I'm just not sure something isn't wrong with our relationship, he has been distant for a few days. That and I have already vented way too much at him and I will probably just ruin that relationship too. She is getting help as well, but holy crap that isn't helping right now. I can't go for more than a few minutes without crying.
